description.short: Envision a customer's human-led, agent-operated Frontier company.
description.full: Plugin for Microsoft Innovation Hub solution envisioning. It gathers customer context from Work IQ (meetings, transcripts, mail, Teams chats and files) and public sources into a cited context pack; builds a hypothesis hybrid Frontier Company Blueprint in the HAIRO style; merges workshop feedback; writes shared-model PRD, solution design, ADRs and readiness documents for MVP agents; creates agent names, colours, icons, identity cards and catalogue; and models business value in CHF with sourced ordinary cost assumptions. The blueprint follows four parts: Vision (Overview, Org model, Blueprint, Journeys, Use cases and PRD); Design (Agents, Agent identity, Target architecture and IT readiness); Build (Roadmap and Plan); Workshops (Attendees, Discovery, Risks and Evidence). The PRD page and design scaffold share requirement identities; the Agent Factory Plan board displays derived readiness and exports handover CSV; risks support evidence-linked workshop ratings and feedback. Attendee contributions cite sources and transcript timestamps. The Overview retains the digital feedback loop through Microsoft IQ (Work IQ, Fabric IQ, Foundry IQ and Web IQ), human approval and measured outcomes. Agent canvases retain the Copilot Studio-style workflow designer with AI, deterministic and human steps. Customer-audience builds remove internal evidence and internal-derived content. Version 1.11.0 ships seven GA product wrappers and optional Preview Envisioning Agent Factory, which prepares a reviewed starter-repository ZIP from a pinned template and envisioning artefacts, not a business runtime or tenant deployment. FinOps is not included in this Cowork ZIP; its source and tests remain in the repository. No installation grants financial, repository, source-transfer or tenant permission. The repository and current development distribution remain private and Microsoft internal; technical export checks do not grant external publication clearance.
